p.PURPOSE: Prove that a central session can derive the same complete goal from files alone, reject ambiguity and stale semantic inputs, respect a valid open explicit formal-offering fence, and carry candidates plus distant work without an LLM call or holder ritual.

facts.CASE-GOLDEN: Render the shipped one-campaign fixture and compare exact GOAL.md bytes to its non-converted golden `expected/GOAL.txt`.
facts.CASE-AMBIGUOUS: Remove `goal_node` while two top-level campaigns are open: `GOAL_NODE_AMBIGUOUS`, no output mutation.
facts.CASE-STALE: Change separately plan bytes, revision, selected node and profile; each makes the old marker stale. Change only interaction mode; it remains current.
facts.CASE-STABLE: Render twice from identical bytes: both outputs are byte-identical and contain no time/model/session data. The Claude condition is one line and at most 4000 UTF-16 units.
facts.CASE-CANDIDATE: Candidate appears under Current candidates and Remaining route, never Accepted boundary.
facts.CASE-CUSTODY-ADVISORY: For an owner-facing central agent, `vacant`, a different holder/session and a stale heartbeat all permit refresh and produce the same canonical bytes; worker callers remain diagnosis-only.
facts.CASE-CUSTODY: Retired v0.2 holder-refusal case. Its successors are `CASE-CUSTODY-ADVISORY`, `CASE-FORMAL-OFFERING` and `CASE-CUSTODY-DRIFT`.
facts.CASE-FORMAL-OFFERING: Only one exactly valid, identity-matching and unterminated `offering` created by an explicit owner-requested formal handoff fences publication. Empty or stale metadata, missing, malformed or mismatched offers, and cancelled or receipted bundles remain advisory and permit refresh.
facts.CASE-CUSTODY-DRIFT: A held-to-held change of holder/session/heartbeat between snapshot and publish does not move a goal input; a non-open to valid-open offer transition invalidates the snapshot and ultimately fences without mutating output.
facts.CASE-MOVED: Move the plan between snapshot and rename twice: `GOAL_INPUT_MOVED`, no partial/temporary output remains.
facts.CASE-CLAUDE-BOUND: Grow candidates and direct children across the cap: deterministic full-entry → ids-only → exact `+N more in GOAL.md` fallback, never arbitrary truncation; mandatory-base overflow refuses only the adapter.

p.PASS: All ten contract cases pass through the twelve focused renderer tests; package check is clean; a real long campaign goal includes its accepted frontier, candidate, complete distant route and final gates, and survives compact/resume without chat context, holder/session arguments or ritual artifacts.
